description: Technical documents (datasheet, assembly guide) for a project's system: every value a query into the UHD model, figures rendered from the CAD artifacts, stand-in test data watermarked until measured data replaces it, and a verifier.

skills.summary: Generate datasheets and assembly guides whose every value is a query into the UHD model
Verify generated technical documents: values, units, stand-in watermarks, layout, coverage

tools.purpose: A Chromium-family browser (Google Chrome, Chromium, Microsoft Edge or Brave), run headless: the datasheet and the assembly guide are laid out, their figures drawn and the PDFs printed with it
tools.install: install Google Chrome, Chromium, Microsoft Edge or Brave (found where each platform installs them), or set CHROME to a browser's executable

tools.purpose: poppler-utils: pdfinfo, pdffonts (document checks) and pdftoppm (review page images)

operations.summary: Build the datasheet and assembly guide (HTML, PDF, bound values) for the project's root system from its model, CAD artifacts and docs/docspec.ts; stand-in test data is refreshed, measured data kept

standins.description: refresh stand-in test data from the model first (true/false)

operations.summary: Verify the built documents against the live model: values, units, placeholders, stand-in marks, images, layout, typography, BOM, assembly coverage; fails on any error
Manufacturing Package: what is made for each unit (boards, mechanical parts, cables) from the providers' standard outputs, with figures from their GLBs
Manufacturing Package: each unit's assembly guide: tools, kit with thumbnails, one illustrated step per planned step (exploded mates, routed cables), connections, torques, coverage
